payload.text: hv, 10 Nov, first-hand in vc's session, on vc's four questions about the arngz work (hv's question and feature request reached vc by way of gtools-vc, hv having typed them into the wrong window; received by vc's date -u of 06:02Z, the rulings after it). hv first: "First thing: let's raise this as an issue (or maybe 2?) and get then fully documented.", then "Make it high if you need to, we're fixing both of these now so it gets fixed either way.", then "I'd file that and fix it as well. No point leaving a known problem lying around. Finders are fixers, remember?", then "Ok, we need to do this now as well as part of this work. I DO NOT WANT MULTIPLE BITTY RELEASES. I want _all_ of this fixed and/or created now in this session." So: (1) issues 0133 (raised to high on hv's word), 0134 and 0135 are filed and fully documented, 0135 on hv's finders-are-fixers ruling after vc reported it as a third candidate it had deliberately not filed; (2) ONE RELEASE, everything together: 0133, 0134, 0135 and the feature go out as one, and vc put the cost on the record before hv chose it, that every work package lands outside intent/ and so voids 2.14.9's runs pinned on 195b1c91, meaning R1, R2, R3 and every tree-scan file must be run again at the new head on top of the new arms; hv chose it knowing, and declined the alternative of cutting 2.14.9 as it stood and shipping this as 2.15.0; (3) THE NUMBER STAYS A PATCH, 2.14.9, against vc's recommendation of 2.15.0 on the ground that a new verb and a new menu item are new functionality rather than a fix, the release number being hv's; the CHANGELOG's existing 2.14.9 unreleased section absorbs the work; (4) the menu reads Discover, which picks the desk from the monitors present, and Save Desk..., which is what Discover... does today, renamed to match its own dialog, with the CLI verb discover keeping its meaning so nothing breaks; (5) when no desk fits, fall back to a named default, arngz auto --default rhad, the notice naming the desk it chose, with vc's caveat accepted that rhad is laptop-only so the fallback moves apps onto the laptop screen even with monitors plugged in. Recorded as ST0032, started and claimed by vc, with five work packages: 01 to 03 the three issues, 04 the feature, 05 the menu, help and CHANGELOG, the menu being Molt-matts config and not Utilz. TWO THINGS HV IS TOLD AND WHICH THIS DECISION DOES NOT SETTLE: utilz-dc is down and ST0031/04 is dc's claimed WIP whose close-out waited on the cut this thread moves, so vc is writing the code here rather than checking dc's, a departure from vc's advisory role recorded so authorship is not misread, and the work still wants a second read by dc or by critic-lua and critic-shell; and decision 74 stands, so no Claude runs a test or a build, every host run books at the desk which agentic-engineering-vc holds with AE's 0.3.x on total focus by hv's own word this morning, and therefore the arms, the tree-scan files and the re-run of R1, R2 and R3 need hv's own run or a desk grant, which is the one part of "all fixed in this session" that this session cannot do alone. Peers read this decision at pickup; cc, dc and ic record no copy.
